## Fixed

- **Missing spaces in the in-app help.** In several help pages a bold or
  code-styled word ran straight into the word after it — for example
  "pressing **Back**restores the list", "force enrolment with the **Require
  MFA**checkboxes", or "behind a reverse proxy, make sure`X-Forwarded-Proto`".
  Nineteen of these ran together across the Dashboard, Students, Student
  Detail, Import, User Management, Scheduled Exports, Program Data,
  Compliance Planning, Program Dashboard and API Keys help pages, and all of
  them now read normally.

- **Stray bold and monospaced spaces tidied up.** In another fifteen places the
  space had been tucked *inside* the highlighted word, so it was rendered bold
  or in the code font along with it. The most visible was a code chip that read
  " Color" with a leading gap inside its grey background. The spaces now sit
  outside the highlight where they belong.

Help text only — no behaviour, data or settings were changed.
